method: Assistant manually compared every v3 record and selected input unit against verbatim sources and the v2 raw response; this is not independent blinded review or a gold standard. Paths use zero-based record indices. Literal provenance and semantic entailment are separate judgments.

findings.detail: The quoted new statement reports Susan's support; it does not explicitly state friendship. The old memory identifies Susan as ThomasSusan, but whether this is sufficient support for the friendship relation is a judgment.
Daniel's independent contribution is omitted, despite the input unit containing it.
The new career and job-search material is new_information but links two unrelated old friendship/support units and omits their quotes.
lately is anchored to a clause also containing a realization; its direct modifier is thinking about career.
The comparative negation isn't supporting ... as much as I'd like is not identified, and job-search intention and role insufficiency remain combined in one record.
no_clear_change is conservative, but the same named employer is directly reaffirmed and support is also defensible.
Promotion is directly stated and recently is attached to the promotion quote.
my consulting firm does not establish that the historical employer changed or ended; v2 had avoided state_change.
consulting firm does not establish a replacement for the historical senior developer title; v2 had avoided state_change.

The compact schema no longer generates explicit founder/operator claims, but the employer/title state_change relations still imply an unsupported career transition. The selected input's raw statement and manual attribute client_milestone do not assert founder/operator.
lately directly modifies feeling relieved; the anchors span the entire source but attach it to employer and title records.
No record's primary new quote states that the consulting firm secured initial clients; that text occurs only in qualifier anchors. The relief is also not its own claim.
The previously unhandled new unit is now cited, but instrumental contacts, opened doors and maintaining relationships remain bundled as one record.
The old lately anchor is not in the linked old memory source; deterministic validation rejects it.
now is not attached to the work-life-balance claim.
Completed transition, relief and healthier work-life balance remain combined; finally pertains to the transition.
The quote says the role transition was completed; it does not prove there will never be another job search.
The simulated experience is labelled a change in attitude to extreme sports even as missing_evidence says the required evidence is absent; v2 avoided this state_change.

The new quotes do not establish that the high-injury-risk reason changed. The missing_evidence text also says continued safety priority affirms that original concern remains operative, which overstates the evidence.
Calling the safety commitment unconflicted by this activity goes beyond the user quote.
For now is classified as plan instead of time, and still prioritize safety is classified as negation despite being an affirmation of continuity.

For now is anchored to both sentences, obscuring that it directly qualifies current enjoyment/seeing where it leads, not necessarily the safety commitment. The simulation anchor belongs to the experience, not a free-standing safety claim.
didn't expect qualifies prior expectation, not actual enjoyment, but is not extracted; enjoyment and greater openness are not separate assertion records.
simulated and recently appear in the experience anchor; this does not repair the unsupported state_change label.
